title: [SOA] Bound outbound reply retries
summary: Outbound replies in the Sales Order Agent now limit retry attempts to five per message, provide a manual retry action, and isolate failures to prevent blocking other messages.
key_points: Failed outbound reply attempts are capped at five per message
Replies that have used up their attempts are suppressed without recurring telemetry
New Retry sending action on the SOA Email Message page resets the attempt count
A failure in one reply no longer stops the remaining messages from being processed
New SOA Reply Attempt table and new reply codeunits track attempts and send replies
quote: cap failed outbound reply attempts at five per message
